name: Machine Intelligence Research Institute
summary: A Berkeley nonprofit founded in 2000 that works to prevent extinction from smarter-than-human AI. For two decades it did technical alignment research; since 2024 its priorities are communications and policy: in 2025 its leaders' book If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies became a New York Times bestseller, and its Technical Governance Team drafted an international agreement to halt the development of superintelligence.
